title: KYE Evidence Decision Map
description: Replayable graph projection of a single decision: typed input nodes flow into rule nodes, which produce obligation nodes, which terminate at a single output node. Each node carries its payload hash and signature so an auditor can re-fetch the payload and verify integrity, and a Replay Engine can recompute the output deterministically. Algorithm internals are not part of this schema.

schema.description: Canonical schema discriminator. Every runtime emitter stamps it and every canonical example carries it; pinned with const so the envelope cannot claim a schema it is not.

id.description: Stable URN of the decision map.

version.description: Schema major version. Pinned to 1 for kye.evidence.decision_map.v1.

decision_id.description: URN of the decision this map explains.

nodes.description: All nodes in the decision graph. Each node represents a typed step in the decision pipeline.

id.description: Locally-unique node identifier within this map.

type.description: Node kind. Inputs → rules → obligations → output.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in audit UIs.

payload_ref.description: Optional content-addressable reference to the node's full payload (e.g. an IPFS CID or KYEID).

payload_hash.description: Hash of the node's canonical payload (algorithm-prefixed, e.g. sha256:...). Required for replay verification.

signature.description: Detached signature over (id, type, payload_hash) by the engine or signer that produced this node.

edges.description: Directed edges expressing data/flow dependencies between nodes.

output_node_id.description: Id of the single 'output' node that carries the final decision.

created_at.description: Time the decision map was emitted.
